evidence.claim: Customer reported: Customer C02354 message: 'I never made this $39.08 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3491361.

Holder C02354-K2|126|-185 identity is compromised: 11 of 13 prior transactions were confirmed fraud in closed cases CC-0631, CC-1450, CC-2589, CC-3537, CC-4436, CC-4721, and CC-4942, establishing that activity matching this baseline represents cloned card abuse.

Card C02354-K2 has 19 confirmed fraud closed cases, including 7 confirmed cases of out-of-region card-present fraud (such as CC-5441, CC-4942, CC-4721, CC-4436, CC-3537, and CC-2589) linked to this exact holder where card-present purchases were executed in region 126 while the cardholder retained the physical card.

Flagged transaction 3491361 ($39.08) was preceded 48 hours earlier on the same compromised holder identity by transaction 3485990 ($40.96) on 2016-11-25, which received a high model fraud score of 0.953 (92.1% historical fraud rate).
Card C02354-K2 belongs to community 152043696 with a fraud lift of 4.0 vs base rate (40% fraud rate vs 10.1% baseline across 5 cards), although it is not part of a device ring (ring_id -1).
Flagged transaction 3491361 has an intermediate model score of 0.359 (historical fraud rate 49.83%) and legacy risk score of 0.48, which does not independently breach the high-risk threshold.
Region 126 has a low fraud lift of 0.19 with only 2 of 522 transactions scoring over 0.5 across 148 cards in the 7-day window, indicating no broader regional fraud outbreak.

Rule R2: Customer denies the transaction: Rule R2: Customer denies the transaction. Recommend `BLOCK_CARD` and `CREATE_CASE`. Add `FILE_REPORT` if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

case.summary: Alert HHG-018 was initiated after customer C02354 disputed an in-person charge of $39.08 (transaction 3491361) on card C02354-K2 in region 126. An investigation of the holder identity revealed it is heavily compromised, with 11 of 13 prior transactions confirmed as fraud across seven closed cases. Furthermore, an unauthorized in-person purchase of $40.96 (transaction 3485990) was executed on the same holder identity 48 hours prior with a high model fraud score of 0.953. The card has a documented history of out-of-region card-present clone activity in region 126 while the customer retained possession of the card. The dispute is confirmed as out-of-region fraud totaling $80.04, resulting in the card being blocked and an investigation case created.
